modules.src/elicitation.ts: classify(params) → Classification; buildOptions(classification) → DialogOption[]; responseForChoice(choice) → ElicitationResult; declineWithMessage(message); AUTO_APPROVE_RESPONSE; DECLINE_REASONS; formatDialogTitle; isMessageOnlySchema; parseFormFields; createElicitationHandler({activeCalls, getFallbackContext, log}) → ElicitationHandler installed through openConnection({ elicitationHandler }).
modules.src/active-call.ts: ActiveCallTracker: tools.ts begins/ends a record {toolName, callId, ctx, signal, notes[]} around each bridged tools/call so the handler reaches the calling ExtensionContext and the tool call's AbortSignal; notes are appended to the tool result as a final text block (`Approval requests during this call: …`).
modules.src/tools.ts: deps.activeCalls (optional) wires the tracker; result content gains the notes block when a request was declined during the call.
modules.src/index.ts: creates the tracker and handler once, passes the handler to openConnection on every (re)start, keeps the last session_start context as the no-call fallback; stopServer waits up to 3 s for an in-flight turn_ended before closing.

auto-approve.condition: message-only schema and _meta tool_name js, connector_id node_repl, codex_approval_kind mcp_tool_call, no codex_sensitive_action true, no codex_requires_user_input true (Codex core user-reviewer rule)
auto-approve.observed: not emitted by the runtime in any run (node_repl_auto_review_required is sent as false); verified with a synthetic payload

tool-approval.condition: message-only schema and codex_approval_kind mcp_tool_call (app access, audio recording, origin access with codex_sensitive_action, downloads/uploads, page assets, raw CDP, WebMCP calls, safety prechecks)
options: Allow for this session (persist includes session)
tool-approval.observed: app access for Finder: 2 requests per cold getApp+getAXState call, 1 after a one-shot Allow on the first op; title `Allow Computer Use to use "Finder"?` / `Computer Use · get_app_state` / `App: Finder`

message-only.condition: message-only schema without codex_approval_kind mcp_tool_call (for example browsing history with sensitive_data)
message-only.observed: classification only (no such request appeared); exercised by 05-browser-use

form.condition: object schema with properties of type string | number | integer | boolean | enum (enum/enumNames or oneOf const/title)
form.ui: field by field: boolean → select True/False, enum → select, string/number/integer → input with minLength/maxLength/min/max/integer validation; Esc on any field → cancel
form.observed: classification only (synthetic payload); no form request appeared

url.reason: pi cannot open URL-based approval requests, so this request was declined.

browser-auth.reason: pi has no browser sign-in surface (QR code or screenshot), so this request was declined.

otp.reason: pi has no one-time-code input surface, so this request was declined.

unsupported.condition: a form property pi cannot render (array/object, missing const in oneOf, non-object schema)
unsupported.reason: pi cannot render this request's form, so this request was declined.

toolApproval: Run the tool and remember this choice for this session
Run the tool and remember this choice for future tool calls
messageOnly: Allow this request and remember this choice for this session
Allow this request and remember this choice for future requests

options.rendering: ctx.ui.select(title, [`<label> — <description>`...], { signal }); title lines: message, connector_name · tool_title|tool_name (js omitted), `Risk: <level>` when not low, one `<display_name>: <value>` line per tool_params_display row
options.persistDetection: `persist` as string or array; session → Allow for this session, always → Always allow (Codex approval_supports_persist_mode)

autoApproval.rule: Codex core review_guardian_mcp_elicitation user-reviewer branch (core/src/session/mcp.rs): server is node_repl/cua_repl, _meta tool_name js, connector_id node_repl, codex_approval_kind mcp_tool_call, codex_sensitive_action !== true, codex_requires_user_input !== true, empty form schema
autoApproval.note: Only applies on this package's cua_repl connection (the handler is installed per connection); logged with the request _meta

noUi.condition: no active bridged call context with hasUI, and no session context with hasUI (print and JSON modes)

_meta.message: This pi session has no interactive approval surface (print or JSON mode); run pi interactively to approve Computer Use requests.

noUi.toolResult: runtime error text `Computer Use was not approved to use Finder` plus the appended block `Approval requests during this call: This pi session has no interactive approval surface …` (verified in --mode json tool_execution_end and in -p)

sessionA.call1: two requests (getApp binding and getAXState both ask for get_app_state); Allow + Allow → accessibility text returned
sessionA.call2: one request → Allow for this session (`_meta.persist: session`) → the second operation of the same call did not ask
sessionA.call3: no request at all; accessibility text returned

sessionB.call1: Cancel → js result isError `Computer Use was not approved to use Finder`
sessionB.call2: first request held 60.0 s then Allow, second request Allow → success; the js call (default timeout_ms 30000) did NOT time out while the request was pending, so the runtime suspends the js timeout during confirmations
sessionB.call3: RPC abort (Esc) while the dialog was open → dialog dismissed through the signal (choice dismissed → cancel), notifications/cancelled sent for the js request, tool result `js was cancelled`, turn_ended Interrupt with outcome aborted
sessionB.nextCall: not exercised after the abort in the same session (the run ended); server stayed connected (agent-settled serverRunning true)

observations.noUiPrint: pi -p: request declined with reason no-ui; model saw the runtime's not-approved error
observations.noUiJson: pi --mode json: tool_execution_end content = [not-approved error, docs block, `Approval requests during this call: …` note]
observations.turnEndedOnQuit: with the pending turn_ended awaited in stopServer (≤ 3 s), a print-mode run logs turn-ended before server-stop (previously `MCP connection closed`)
observations.sessionGrantScope: the session grant lived in the cua_repl process / native service for the pi session; a new pi session (new server process and session_id) asked again

sideEffects.getStateUnchanged: 03 getState behavior unchanged (two-call runs in 04 started with getApp; earlier getState runs in the same build passed)
sideEffects.escDuringDialog: cancels the dialog, the pi tool call and the MCP request; the connection stayed usable (agent-settled serverRunning true)
sideEffects.turnEndedOnce: exactly one turn-ended per run in sessions A and B
sideEffects.buildCheck: npm run build and npm run check pass
sideEffects.codexDesktop: not re-tested (skipped; Codex Desktop kept running with its own processes untouched)
sideEffects.processes: cua-repl process count back to Codex Desktop's baseline (30) after every run
